thread:
ashwin: heads-up — smoke eval failing on qlora-7b-q4 bring-up. mismatch between eval harness sample provenance and our curation DB. about ~2% of samples flagged as duplicate but dedupe tag is missing so they slip into holdout. stack traces show provenance join returning NULL for orig_id in many rows.

marta: saw this too. suspect the recent ingest change that renamed source_id -> orig_id (deploy last night) broke the join. same shard range as the failed jobs?

jordan: repro steps? can we get a minimal command to run locally?

ashwin: repro command i used:

```
./scripts/run_eval.sh --model redwood/qlora-7b-q4 --promptset buckets/longtail_v2 --dry-run --log-level debug
```

On debug logs: provenance join SQL returns rows with `orig_id` == NULL for a subset. those rows have non-null `legacy_source` values tho.

samir: quick mitigation: fallback join on legacy_source if orig_id is NULL, then flag records for re-ingest. that would avoid dropping samples in the eval. but we should also re-run dedupe/backfill for affected shards. how many samples are we talking about?

ashwin: ~12k samples across shard_7 and shard_9. skewed toward low-frequency languages (bn, ne, id). also saw a quant-related tokenization oddity in perf logs — token lengths differ between float and quant paths by 1 token in some prompts, so near-duplicate detection using hashing may be brittle.

marta: i'll patch the ingest service to add the fallback (orig_id || legacy_source) and kick a backfill on test cluster first. can someone do a small manual QC on 300 samples so we can sanity check the fix before prod? @jordan are you able to run that?

jordan: can do the 300-sample QC. i'll stratify by language and by whether the provenance was legacy vs orig. SQL to pull stratified sample:

```
SELECT sample_id, prompt, lang, COALESCE(orig_id, legacy_source) as prov_key
FROM curation.samples
WHERE shard IN (7,9)
AND dataset='longtail_v2'
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 300;
```

will upload CSV to shared drive when done. :thumbsup:

label-bot: scheduled job `dedupe-backfill-342` created for shards [7,9]. estimated runtime ~2h. monitoring attached.

samir: i'll also add a regression alert on benchboard comparing pre-quant vs qlora-7b-q4 tokenization+dedupe delta. created PR: https://git.internal/redwood/benchboard/pulls/128 (draft).

marta: good — after backfill and ingest patch we should re-run the full eval harness and compare these metrics: exact_match, logical_failure_rate, hallucination_score. capture both tokenization distributions and dedupe-hit-rate. i'll post the diffs to #eng-ml.

ashwin: moving change to hotfix branch `redwood/ingest#402-hotfix`. tagging infra-runner for prod patch window. thanks for quick responses. :heart:

jordan: uploaded the 300-sample QC CSV to /shared/curation/qc/3422109876_qc.csv and left short notes on samples with ambiguous provenance.

marta: closing loop for now — i'll post results of test backfill and the eval diff. if production shows any customer-facing regressions we'll open a short postmortem.
